title.narrative: Transformation of Belle Mare into a Climate-Smart Agriculture village for climate resilience, food security, and poverty alleviation of its farmers

description.narrative: The overall aim of this work is to transform Belle Mare into a model Climate Smart Agricultural Village so that its farmers will be climate resilient and enjoy sustainable livelihoods, food production is increased in an environmentally friendly manner, and lower levels of greenhouse gases are emitted.
